Remission & chronicity

Spontaneous remission
Spontaneous clearance in <30% of acute cases; chronic infection rarely clears without treatment (<1%/year)
Best-intervention remission
>95% cured (sustained virologic response at 12 weeks) with 8-12 week courses of direct-acting antivirals (DAAs)
Drug-free remission
—
Relapse after remission
—
Chronicity
—
Gap size
Near-zero biological gap; large access/utilization gap
Primary barrier
access
Barrier detail: Only 65% of eligible patients with private insurance received DAA treatment as of 2020; rates declining since 2019; Medicaid restrictions remain in many states; $20,000+ drug cost for generics unavailable in US

Last SoC change: 2014-2016 — DAA revolution (sofosbuvir 2013, ledipasvir/sofosbuvir 2014, pan-genotypic regimens 2016-2017); prior interferon-ribavirin standard unchanged since ~2001 with <50% efficacy and severe side effects

Remission data layers: disease_db_100 · source-locked manual data · confidence: high
